name: nether-gate
description: Nether Gate (nether_gate, nether_gate_2), rebuilt blind for ROADMAP 52 (tools/blueprints/REBUILD.md). MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. LEVEL=1|2 picks the level; 'build' writes both candidates.

scripts.build: npm run build:1 && npm run build:2
scripts.build:1: rm -rf out && LEVEL=1 node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py nether_gate nether_gate --candidate
scripts.build:2: rm -rf out && LEVEL=2 node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py nether_gate nether_gate_2 --candidate
